brief:
Liberal Zionists distance themselves from Israeli voter preferences while ultimately defending apartheid structures, Mondoweiss reported. The outlet contends that despite criticism of ultra-nationalist extremists and pro-Palestine activists, liberal Zionists consistently defend Israeli policies when confronted with electoral outcomes.

Israel's latest elections demonstrated voter support for positions that liberal Zionists publicly oppose, according to the analysis. Mondoweiss argues this pattern reveals a fundamental contradiction in liberal Zionist ideology and its relationship to Israeli state policies.
dek: Liberal Zionists bemoan both ultra-nationalist extremists and pro-Palestine activists, but Israel's latest elections show how they ultimately come to the defense of apartheid every time.
title: Israeli election results expose liberal Zionist positions, Mondoweiss argues
